title: Show HN: Quake ported to safe Rust, playable in browser
summary: A Show HN post about a Quake port written in safe Rust that runs playable in the browser. The submission links to a live demo and a Hacker News discussion with 230 points and 176 comments. Despite being framed as AI/ML content, the project is a game engine port and does not involve machine learning, LLMs, or AI techniques.
